name: Palau-sator (Spain)
description: Tierced horizontally, yellow above, barry wavy of white and light blue in the middle and white below, with a red pale at the hoist bearing a yellow donjoned palace.
history: The current flag of Palau-sator is a flag of 2:3, tierced horizontally, yellow in the first third, barry wavy of three white and three light blue pieces of three and a half crests in the second, and white in the third, with a red pale at the hoist edge; the donjoned palace is a traditional canting sign referring to the name (arms approved 22 September 1995).

features.role: fly tierced yellow, barry wavy and white
three light blue wavy stripes in the middle third
donjoned palace of the arms on the red pale
